notes.title: Patch 001
notes.content:
1. Added soft save states for all bosses (Snake, Meatball, Rat King, Fida). Instead of restarting the room, game will pick up from the beginning of the boss fight.

2. Added small minecart check points so room will restart if player gets stuck in between two ramps.

3. Nerfed all spinning gear targets (except for the Rat King). Takes fewer hits to break gear targets.

Hope these small updates will help the players experience. Enjoy!
-Ryan
